review_basis: Checked against the pinned Analog Devices Rev. G PDF pages named by each evidence item. Acceptance changes review status only and supplies no register or transition semantics.
limitations: The 0x53 address is a board-selection input; the datasheet also permits 0x1D.
The accepted model is only the requested INT_SOURCE and FIFO_CTL behavior slice.
External event generation and FIFO population are scenario stimuli, not extracted device transitions.
Extractor confidence values are uncalibrated and were not used as an acceptance threshold.
